name: dsh-subagent-templates
description: Named subagent templates: each template fixes a starting route — one provider/model pair, or a route pool a route is resolved from per child — an agent preset, and an optional persona, so a delegating agent picks a template by name instead of configuring provider, model, and reasoning effort per call, and a background template child's output is delivered to its parent without a collection call.
author: windwhiterain

meta.title: Subagent Templates
meta.description: Delegates to a subagent built from a named template that fixes its route (or the pool it resolves one from), agent preset, and persona.
